title: Focker-in-Law Director Praises Ariana Grande's Comedy Skills
excerpt:
John Hamburg discusses casting Ariana Grande in the fourth franchise installment.
He also reveals which longtime collaborator makes Ben Stiller laugh most.
body_md:
Twenty-six years after Meet the Parents earned $330 million worldwide, longtime franchise writer John Hamburg directs its fourth installment, opening November 25, 2026. Ben Stiller, Robert De Niro, Teri Polo and Owen Wilson return alongside newcomers including Ariana Grande.

Hamburg says the team needed a compelling reason to revisit the characters. Stiller approaching the age De Niro was during the original production offered a natural reversal of roles. Greg Focker now faces his son's girlfriend, Olivia Jones, a hostage negotiator who views Greg's overinvolvement as emotionally restrictive.

Grande emerged as Hamburg's choice after he developed the character. Her Saturday Night Live appearances impressed him with their comic timing. He describes her as an intelligent performer who understood Olivia and challenged him to explore alternatives, delivering different levels of intensity that could be refined during editing.

Skyler Gisondo plays Greg's son Henry. His previous collaboration with Stiller in Night at the Museum helped establish a convincing father-son relationship, which Hamburg considers central to the film's emotional appeal.

Hamburg identifies Owen Wilson as the performer who makes Stiller laugh most readily between takes. He also discusses his habit of writing in focused 25-minute sessions and his hopes for theatrical comedy. Although he cannot predict the film's commercial performance, he remains optimistic about the value of audiences laughing together.
